upload.intro: Upload a CSV with your bank movements. We automatically detect the columns and categorize expenses by merchant (Mercadona → Groceries, Repsol → Transport, etc.). Before importing anything, you review and edit everything you want.

uploader.dropText: Drag your CSV here or tap to choose
uploader.hint: Your bank usually exports it from "Movements → Export"

errors.noColumnsDetected: No columns were detected. Does the file have headers?
errors.noDataRows: The file contains no data rows.

mapping.title: Column mapping
mapping.description: Assign which CSV column corresponds to each field. If your bank uses two separate columns for income and expenses (Credit / Debit), fill those in instead of "Amount".
mapping.validationWarningSuffix: column and at least one amount column (Amount, or Credit/Debit) to continue.

preview.empty: No movements left. Upload another CSV or adjust the column mapping.
preview.hint: Click "Expense" / "Income" to change the type. Edit any field directly. Tap the trash icon to discard a row.

done.title: Import complete!
done.messageSuffix: movements to your account. They're distributed by their real dates on the calendar.
